Worldscope Calibration Ledger

Every camera with calibration work on disk: the constraints used to solve it — clicked map ↔ pixel points, summit landmarks, star and sun observations — plus the solved parameters, pointing, and reprojection error. Pointing az/tilt is derived from each stored rotation matrix; RMS is recomputed from the stored points where the solver didn't record one.
